A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<table><tr><td><img src="a.svg" alt="A"> <a href="/1">x</a></td><td><a href="/2">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href="/3">z</a></td></tr></table>"#;
    let options: ConversionOptions = Default::default();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
